decisions.quote: Our Study 1 examines whether the Knoppen and Saris findings generalize to a representative sample of the German population. With some notable exceptions, our findings replicate theirs.
decisions.reason: Both the shipped record and blind coding agree on 'replication'. Study 1 tests whether Knoppen and Saris's (2009b) PVQ factor-structure findings from German student samples hold in a different, representative German national sample (Hinz et al., 2005; N = 1,966).

corrected_value.title: Evaluation of the portrait values questionnaire using SEM: A new ESS proposal

decisions.quote: Knoppen, D., & Saris, W. E. (2009b). Evaluation of the Portrait Values Questionnaire using SEM: A new ESS Proposal. Paper presented at the QMSS2 seminar at Bolzano, Italy, June 11-12.
decisions.reason: Shipped row 223 matches blind target 1 (Knoppen & Saris, 2009b). Section 3.3 explicitly states that Study 1 followed the three-step procedure of and compared its outcomes against Knoppen and Saris (2009b), and all pairwise empirical comparisons in Section 3.4 are made against 2009b.

decisions.quote: Study 1 followed the procedures of Knoppen and Saris (2009a,b) to investigate the measurement models of the ten values as measured by the 40-item PVQ. Our findings in a representative German national sample largely support those that Knoppen and Saris reported for homogeneous samples of German students. But there were notable exceptions, too.
decisions.reason: Both the shipped record and blind coding agree on 'mixed'. The authors explicitly frame their findings in the abstract and discussion as replicating/supporting Knoppen and Saris with notable exceptions (e.g., replicating sub-dimensions for achievement, security, universalism, and self-direction as well as specific cross-loadings, while failing to find conformity sub-dimensions or tradition item clusters reported in 2009b).

decisions.quote: Finally, we compared the outcomes of our analysis with those reported by Knoppen and Saris (2009b).
decisions.reason: Although the paper cites Knoppen and Saris (2009a,b) jointly in headings and general discussion when referring to their student-sample research, the title frames the study as a replication of a single work ('Knoppen and Saris (2009)') and Section 3.3 explicitly states that Study 1 followed the three-step procedure of and compared its analysis outcomes with those reported by Knoppen and Saris (2009b). Every specific empirical comparison in Results (Section 3.4) and Discussion (Section 3.5) is cited exclusively to 2009b, with no separate findings from 2009a independently tested or compared. Thus target 0 (2009a) is a companion citation rather than a separate omitted replication target.
